additional_info.subject: Question from RC
additional_info.body:
The screen is sometimes not responding to touch (but it works to display the action, e.g. estop or charging).
After a reboot, the screen will respond to touch.
This issue was flagged by the customer a long time ago.
It was an issue before the HMI was replaced and we were hoping it was to do with the driver, but it appears to still be an issue even after the HMI has been replaced (Gen1 -> Gen2)
It suggested that the PCB should be inspected to make sure the ribbon cables are in place, but seeing as this issue also happened prior to the screen replacement I believe it must be something in the charger system.
We would like to replace the DP cable and also the USB cable, could you please provide us with the spare part number or type of USB that it should be?
Additionally, please provide any other steps that you could suggest, I believe doing the driver update will not resolve it, unless Gen2 HMI drivers are not updated from factory.

Hello Ferdinand,
This is a known issue. I can see that this charger is running an old version. The newer version of the SiCharge D includes an automatic reboot of the screen driver.
Would it be possible to update the charger to version 7.0.5 and monitor its behavior afterward?
